ABSORPTION_ESTIMATE_UNAVAILABLE.condition: A capillary radius or plate thickness was declared and the absorption estimate recorded why it was skipped (`record.skipped`).
ABSORPTION_ESTIMATE_UNAVAILABLE.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

ABSORPTION_MU_R_OUT_OF_RANGE.condition: The estimated µR lies past `CYLINDER_MU_R_MAX`, the end of the published fit the capillary correction uses.
ABSORPTION_MU_R_OUT_OF_RANGE.kind_reason: The published fit's range is a fact about the correction, not a judgement about the data.

ABSORPTION_PLATE_THICKNESS.condition: Under `flat_plate_transmission`, the declared thickness gives under 0.7 of the counts the optimal thickness would (the inline literal 0.7).
ABSORPTION_PLATE_THICKNESS.kind_reason: The fraction of the optimal counts is arithmetic on the declared µt; the threshold decides only when it is said, and the code suggests nothing.
ABSORPTION_PLATE_THICKNESS.note: Gated by an inline literal (0.7), one of the two the WP names.

ABSORPTION_THICKNESS_MATTERS.condition: Under a flat-plate geometry, the declared thickness moves the equivalent Biso by more than `FLAT_PLATE_BIAS_MIN`.
ABSORPTION_THICKNESS_MATTERS.kind_reason: The equivalent ΔBiso is arithmetic on the declared µt; the threshold decides only when it is said.

ADP_NOT_POSITIVE_DEFINITE.condition: A refined anisotropic displacement tensor has a negative eigenvalue (`staged.check_adp_positive_definite`).
ADP_NOT_POSITIVE_DEFINITE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
ADP_NOT_POSITIVE_DEFINITE.note: Raised from a guard finding; its test is in `strategy/staged.py` (WP-2002's walk).

AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED.condition: A spline background with no air-scatter term, where a 1/(2θ) column would remove at least `AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED_FRACTION` of χ² at a score of at least `AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED_SCORE`.
AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED.kind_reason: Issue #1215 names a second explanation, a background too stiff at the low edge; the alternatives are enumerable and a refit scores each, while the code names one.
AIR_SCATTER_UNDECLARED.note: Issue #1215 (in the WP's Inherited): fires on 20/20 clean synthetic patterns under the P-spline, by the issue's count.

BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION.condition: The projection R² of a structural column onto the background span exceeds `staged.BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION_GUARD` (0.25).
BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION.kind_reason: Whether a given overlap biases the quantity the caller wants depends on the purpose, which the pattern does not carry.

BACKGROUND_ORDER_AT_CAP.condition: The Chebyshev order scan ended at `CHEBYSHEV_MAX_ORDER` without its Durbin-Watson stop firing.
BACKGROUND_ORDER_AT_CAP.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

BISO_NEGATIVE.condition: A refined isotropic displacement parameter is below zero (`staged.check_biso_negative`).
BISO_NEGATIVE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
BISO_NEGATIVE.note: Raised from a guard finding in `strategy/staged.py`.

BISO_UNUSUALLY_LARGE.condition: A refined Biso exceeds the Lindemann melting amplitude for the cell (`staged.LINDEMANN_RHO`).
BISO_UNUSUALLY_LARGE.kind_reason: Static disorder or a wrong site can exceed the thermal bound in a sound model; which one holds is a fact about the sample.
BISO_UNUSUALLY_LARGE.note: Raised from a guard finding; `LINDEMANN_RHO` is tier 2 there.

BOUND_HIT.condition: A refined value finished on a declared limit that carried load (`staged.bound_findings`).
BOUND_HIT.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.
BOUND_HIT.note: Its tests are `staged.BOUND_HIT_*`, tiered in WP-2002's walk.

BRINDLEY_OUTSIDE_REGIME.condition: A phase's µR exceeds `qpa.BRINDLEY_MU_R_FENCE`, the regime the Brindley correction was published for.
BRINDLEY_OUTSIDE_REGIME.kind_reason: The regime is the correction's published range, a fact about the method.

CAPILLARY_OFFSET_UNAVAILABLE.condition: A capillary geometry carries no goniometer radius, so the specimen-offset terms are held at zero.
CAPILLARY_OFFSET_UNAVAILABLE.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

CELL_DEGENERATE_PROBE.condition: The solver tried at least one trial cell with zero or negative volume during the stage.
CELL_DEGENERATE_PROBE.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

CELL_RUNAWAY.condition: A free cell parameter left the window `CELL_SAFETY_FRACTION` / `CELL_SAFETY_ANGLE_DEG` around its starting value.
CELL_RUNAWAY.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 3, approved); copied here, not re-judged.

CONSTRAINT_ACTIVE.condition: In the final stage the LM driver held at least one step against a built-in inequality (the Stephens cone or Γ_G² ≥ 1e-8).
CONSTRAINT_ACTIVE.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

COVARIANCE_DIRECTION_DISCARDED.condition: The covariance build discarded a direction several parameters share (`staged.check_discarded_directions`).
COVARIANCE_DIRECTION_DISCARDED.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

COVARIANCE_UNAVAILABLE.condition: The solver returned and the esd calculation raised afterwards.
COVARIANCE_UNAVAILABLE.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

DATA_SUPPORT_LOW.condition: Independent reflections per structural parameter fall below `OBS_PER_PARAMETER_PREFERRED` (info) or `OBS_PER_PARAMETER_MIN` (warning).
DATA_SUPPORT_LOW.kind_reason: The count is arithmetic and the bands are quoted from the literature (CLAUDE.md, WP-1071); they set the level alone.

DECLARED_RANGE_NOT_RESTORED.condition: An older file stored a hand-set parameter with no limits, and migration found no declared range to restore.
DECLARED_RANGE_NOT_RESTORED.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

DECLARED_RANGE_RESTORED.condition: An older file stored a hand-set parameter with no limits, and migration restored its declared range (a warning where the value sits on it).
DECLARED_RANGE_RESTORED.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

DISPERSION_NEGLECTED.condition: Anomalous scattering is off, and |f|² at this wavelength differs from Z² by at least `DISPERSION_NEGLECT_FRAC` for some element (a warning from `DISPERSION_NEGLECT_SEVERE`).
DISPERSION_NEGLECTED.kind_reason: The relative change is arithmetic on tabulated f′ and f″; the thresholds set when and how loudly.

EXTRA_PEAK_NO_INTENSITY.condition: A declared extra peak's area finished on its zero floor (`BOUND_HIT_RTOL`).
EXTRA_PEAK_NO_INTENSITY.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

EXTRA_PEAK_ON_REFLECTION.condition: A declared extra peak lies within `LAYER0_MATCH_TOL_DEG` (0.08°) of a predicted reflection.
EXTRA_PEAK_ON_REFLECTION.kind_reason: A duplicate of the reflection and an impurity line at nearly the same angle are both possible, and a refit with and without the peak scores them.
EXTRA_PEAK_ON_REFLECTION.note: The tolerance is a fixed angle, not a fraction of the local FWHM.

FLAT_DIRECTION.condition: Two free parameters are correlated at or above `staged.FLAT_DIRECTION_RHO` (1 − 5e-4).
FLAT_DIRECTION.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

FLOOR_HIT.condition: A scale, width or similar quantity finished on its zero floor and the data push it lower (`staged.bound_findings`).
FLOOR_HIT.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

FROZEN_COMPILE_STALE.condition: A fresh compile at the returned parameters changes χ² by more than `FROZEN_COMPILE_CHI2_REL` of itself.
FROZEN_COMPILE_STALE.kind_reason: The relative change is measured directly; the threshold decides only when it is said.

HARMONIC_ABSENT.condition: A declared harmonic's refined fraction is below `HARMONIC_ABSENT_FRAC`.
HARMONIC_ABSENT.kind_reason: Whether a fraction is distinguishable from zero is a statistical question the data settle; the code answers it with a fixed fraction rather than the esd, which is the threshold's question for part 2.
HARMONIC_ABSENT.note: An absolute fraction, not a significance test.

HARMONIC_FRACTION.condition: A declared harmonic refined to a measurable fraction; a warning above `HARMONIC_IMPLAUSIBLE_FRAC`.
HARMONIC_FRACTION.kind_reason: Whether a fraction is plausible depends on the monochromator and the detector's energy window, facts outside the pattern.

HARMONIC_HELD.condition: A declared harmonic's weight was not free, so it did not enter the fit.
HARMONIC_HELD.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

HIGH_CORRELATION.condition: Two free parameters are correlated above the stage's `correlation_guard` (`schemas.plan.CORRELATION_GUARD`, 0.98).
HIGH_CORRELATION.kind_reason: Whether a correlation of this size harms the quantity the caller wants depends on the purpose; WP-2037's response column is the package's answer to that.
HIGH_CORRELATION.note: The threshold is in `schemas/plan.py` (WP-2002's walk), unaudited there; B13 handed it here.

HOLD_BLOCKED_PLAN.condition: A stage's `turn_on` glob matched a parameter the caller had held, so it stayed fixed.
HOLD_BLOCKED_PLAN.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

HUMP_TOO_NARROW.condition: A declared background hump narrowed below `staged.HUMP_MIN_WIDTH_MULT` times the instrumental width.
HUMP_TOO_NARROW.kind_reason: An unindexed Bragg line and a real narrow diffuse feature are both possible, and the data can score a peak against a hump.
HUMP_TOO_NARROW.note: `HUMP_MIN_WIDTH_MULT` is in `strategy/staged.py`, unaudited; B13 handed it here.

LEBAIL_ALTERNATION_STOPPED.condition: The Le Bail alternation stopped; info when it converged, a warning for any other reason.
LEBAIL_ALTERNATION_STOPPED.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

LEBAIL_CYCLES_AT_CAP.condition: The intensity partition reached the cap `lebail_cycles` before the intensities stopped moving.
LEBAIL_CYCLES_AT_CAP.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED.condition: Below the first reflection less two FWHM, the mean (Δ/σ)² over at least `LOW_ANGLE_MIN_CHANNELS` channels exceeds `LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED_RATIO` times χ²_red.
LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED.kind_reason: Issue #1219 names three competent responses (air scatter, a beam-stop cut, a real diffuse component), and which applies depends on the measurement, outside the pattern.
LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED.note: Two inline literals: the 2 FWHM region edge and the 2σ channel test that places the suggested lower limit. Issue #1219 proposes dropping the suggestion.

MAGNETIC_WIDTH_MOVED_MOMENT.condition: Freeing the magnetic broadening moved a released moment by more than `MAGNETIC_WIDTH_MOMENT_SHIFT_SIGMA` esds.
MAGNETIC_WIDTH_MOVED_MOMENT.kind_reason: The shift is measured in its own esd; the threshold decides only when it is said.

MICROABSORPTION_SKIPPED.condition: A particle radius was given for at least one phase and the Brindley correction could not run (`qpa.microabsorption_skipped`).
MICROABSORPTION_SKIPPED.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

MODEL_FAR_FROM_DATA.condition: Rwp exceeds `MODEL_FAR_FROM_DATA_RWP` (0.8), at an error level.
MODEL_FAR_FROM_DATA.kind_reason: No competent refiner reads an Rwp near that of a model predicting no intensity as a fit; the threshold row is tier 3 on its own.
MODEL_FAR_FROM_DATA.note: Error level: a series escalates and quarantines on it (WP-2003, the WP's Inherited).

NEUTRON_RESONANT_ABSORBER.condition: Under a neutron source, the structure holds an element with a complex scattering length near a resonance; a warning from `RESONANT_ABSORBER_SEVERE_BARN`.
NEUTRON_RESONANT_ABSORBER.kind_reason: The tabulated absorption is a nuclear fact; the threshold sets the level alone.

OCCUPANCY_ABOVE_ONE.condition: A refined site occupancy is above 1.
OCCUPANCY_ABOVE_ONE.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 3 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.
OCCUPANCY_ABOVE_ONE.note: No significance gate; whether to add one is the maintainer's (WP-2002's handover, in the WP's Inherited).

ORIGIN_FIXED_ON_POLAR_AXIS.condition: The space group is polar and the package held the origin along the polar axis (`_origin_diagnostics`, `_centroid_finding`).
ORIGIN_FIXED_ON_POLAR_AXIS.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

ORIGIN_NOT_FIXED.condition: The space group is polar and nothing holds the origin along its polar axis.

PATTERN_DEAD_CHANNELS.condition: With a measured σ, a short run of fitted channels reads far below the local background and its σ shrank with it (`background.diagnostics.dead_channels`).
PATTERN_DEAD_CHANNELS.kind_reason: Counts below a smooth background with σ shrinking alongside are a detector fault; no diffraction physics produces the pair.

PATTERN_UNDERSAMPLED.condition: The typical peak spans fewer than `STEPS_PER_FWHM_MIN` points per FWHM.
PATTERN_UNDERSAMPLED.kind_reason: The band is quoted from the literature (tier 2); it sets the level alone.

PAWLEY_OFF_DATA_RIDGED.condition: Some Pawley reflections have no emission line centred inside the fitted data, and their intensities are ridged.
PAWLEY_OFF_DATA_RIDGED.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

PAWLEY_OVERLAP_UNRESOLVED.condition: In an overlap group the largest esd/|I| reaches `PAWLEY_UNRESOLVED_REL`.
PAWLEY_OVERLAP_UNRESOLVED.kind_reason: The relative esd is measured; the threshold decides only when it is said.

PHASE_UNCONSTRAINED.condition: A phase with free non-scale paths, held paths or no measured scale has a scale under `PHASE_SUPPORT_SIGMA` of its counting-noise esd, or no line in range (a single-phase model only where something was held); the message says what was held, the instrument included.
PHASE_UNCONSTRAINED.kind_reason: The hold passes the judgement ground (milestone § The rule); only its 3σ is on trial, and that is WP-2002's.
PHASE_UNCONSTRAINED.note: The action is WP-2002's; this WP owns the code.

PLAN_FREES_NO_MOMENT.condition: The structure carries a magnetic moment and no stage of the plan frees it.
PLAN_FREES_NO_MOMENT.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

QPA_ESD_UNAVAILABLE.condition: A phase scale refined to a value where its esd could not be measured.
QPA_ESD_UNAVAILABLE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

QPA_UNAVAILABLE.condition: The weighted scales sum to zero or less, so no weight fractions exist.
QPA_UNAVAILABLE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

RESOLUTION_NOT_POSITIVE.condition: An instrument width is negative somewhere in the fitted range (`staged.check_resolution_positive`).
RESOLUTION_NOT_POSITIVE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

RESOLUTION_UNCONSTRAINED.condition: Gaussian resolution terms were free while more than half the fitted channels are Lorentzian-dominated (`staged.check_resolution_supported`).
RESOLUTION_UNCONSTRAINED.kind_reason: The Lorentzian share is arithmetic on the refined widths.
RESOLUTION_UNCONSTRAINED.note: The 'more than half' is an inline literal in `strategy/staged.py` (`lorentzian.sum() * 2 <= tt.size`), outside this WP's file.

RESTRAINT_PAIRS_STALE.condition: At the end of the run a phase's anti-bump restraints missed contacts closer than their minimum distance.
RESTRAINT_PAIRS_STALE.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

RESTRAINT_TENSION.condition: A soft restraint finished more than `RESTRAINT_TENSION_SIGMA` of its own σ from its target.
RESTRAINT_TENSION.kind_reason: Whether the restraint or the data is wrong depends on chemistry outside the pattern.

RIGID_BODY_UNSUPPORTED.condition: A free rotation or shift of a rigid body has a zero column.
RIGID_BODY_UNSUPPORTED.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

ROUGHNESS_ABSORPTION.condition: The roughness column's projection R² onto displacement, scale and background exceeds `staged.ROUGHNESS_ABSORPTION_GUARD` (0.9).
ROUGHNESS_ABSORPTION.kind_reason: As for `BACKGROUND_ABSORPTION`: whether the overlap harms the quantity wanted depends on the purpose.

ROUGHNESS_OUTSIDE_REGIME.condition: Under the Pitschke model, τ exceeds sin θ_min (a warning) or half of it (info).
ROUGHNESS_OUTSIDE_REGIME.kind_reason: The model's regime is from its paper; the half that sets the info band is an inline literal.
ROUGHNESS_OUTSIDE_REGIME.note: Inline literal 0.5 for the info band.

ROUGHNESS_UNCONSTRAINED.condition: The refined roughness changes every modelled reflection's intensity by less than `ROUGHNESS_MIN_DEPRESSION`.
ROUGHNESS_UNCONSTRAINED.kind_reason: The depression is arithmetic on the refined model; the threshold decides only when it is said.

SCALE_B_INSEPARABLE.condition: Over the fitted range a phase's scale and Biso columns separate by less than `SCALE_B_SEPARATION_FLOOR`.
SCALE_B_INSEPARABLE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

SITE_DOFS_RENUMBERED.condition: A site moved onto or off a special position and a hold, tie or free path sat on one of its renumbered DOFs.
SITE_DOFS_RENUMBERED.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

SIZE_UNUSUALLY_SMALL.condition: A phase's size broadening implies a crystallite size below `SIZE_FLAG_SIZE_A` (Scherrer, `SCHERRER_K`).
SIZE_UNUSUALLY_SMALL.kind_reason: A small crystallite is a real outcome of synthesis or milling; whether it is a defect depends on the sample.
SIZE_UNUSUALLY_SMALL.note: Calibrated on one 1 213-record archive (the WP's Families): one family.

SPECIES_FALLBACK_NEUTRAL.condition: An ion named for a site has no form-factor entry, so the neutral atom's was used.
SPECIES_FALLBACK_NEUTRAL.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

STAGE_FREES_MAGNETIC_WIDTH_WITH_MOMENT.condition: A stage frees the magnetic broadening in the stage that first frees the moment.
STAGE_FREES_MAGNETIC_WIDTH_WITH_MOMENT.kind_reason: The two orders are enumerable and a refit of each scores them; the code asserts one.

STAGE_MAX_ITER.condition: A stage ran out of iterations before it converged.
STAGE_MAX_ITER.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

STAGE_NOT_FINITE.condition: The model held a NaN or an infinity at a point the solver reached.
STAGE_NOT_FINITE.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

STAGE_PATH_NOT_FREE.condition: A stage asked to refine a path that symmetry or the model fixes, or that follows another.
STAGE_PATH_NOT_FREE.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

STAGE_PATH_UNKNOWN.condition: A stage named a path no parameter of the model has.
STAGE_PATH_UNKNOWN.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

STAGE_SLOW_DESCENT.condition: The stage stopped with its cost still falling, too slowly to move a parameter by one esd in 300 more evaluations.
STAGE_SLOW_DESCENT.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 1 (tier 1); copied here, not re-judged.

STAGE_WINDOWS_STALE.condition: The last declared stage (and the closing stage) ended with a peak-area share outside its frozen windows above the window tolerance it ran at.
STAGE_WINDOWS_STALE.kind_reason: The audit row already carries ambiguity 3 (tier 3, approved); copied here, not re-judged.

STEPHENS_STRAIN_NOT_POSITIVE.condition: The refined Stephens coefficients give a negative variance at some reflections (`staged.check_stephens_positive`).
STEPHENS_STRAIN_NOT_POSITIVE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

STRAIN_UNUSUALLY_LARGE.kind_reason: Large strain is a real outcome of deformation or composition gradients; whether it is a defect depends on the sample.
STRAIN_UNUSUALLY_LARGE.note: Calibrated on one 1 213-record archive (the WP's Families): one family.

TEXTURE_NOT_POSITIVE.condition: The truncated spherical-harmonics series goes below zero on the sphere (`staged.check_texture_positive`).
TEXTURE_NOT_POSITIVE.kind_reason: It states a fact the model or the arithmetic fixes, and every competent refiner reads the number the same way.

WAVELENGTH_CALIBRATION.condition: A wavelength was free in the fit; the message gives its shift from the declared value in ppm, with no test on its size.
WAVELENGTH_CALIBRATION.kind_reason: It records something the package did or declined to do, which no reading of the data changes.

_bic|1e-300|max(rss, 1e-300).reason: Keeps log(RSS) finite for an exact fit.

select_chebyshev_order|4|m < max_order *.reason: Refuses an order scan with fewer than four background channels per order; it raises a ValueError, not a code, so no verdict of this WP rests on it.

_absorption_diagnostics|100|100 * residu.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_absorption_diagnostics|0.7|record.inten.reason: Gates `ABSORPTION_PLATE_THICKNESS`: the plate gives under 70 % of the optimal thickness's counts. To lift into a named constant at part 2.

_absorption_diagnostics|100|100 * record.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_air_scatter_undeclared_diagnostics|0.00.reason: Keeps 1/(2θ) finite at 2θ = 0; a fitted range never reaches 0.001°.

_frozen_compile_diagnostics|100|100 * re.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_harmonic_diagnostics|100.0|100.0 * frac.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_harmonic_diagnostics|100.0|100.0 * esd.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_hold_diagnostics|5|n > 5.reason: The message lists the first five held paths (`where[:5]`) and marks the rest with an ellipsis; `where` carries them all.

_lebail_stop_diagnostic|100|100 * r.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_low_angle_diagnostics|2.0|first_tick -.reason: Sets the low-angle region's upper edge at two FWHM below the first reflection, so it decides which channels `LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED` reads. To lift at part 2.

_low_angle_diagnostics|2|np.mean(weighte.reason: The square in the mean of (Δ/σ)².

_low_angle_diagnostics|2.0|np.abs(weight.reason: The 2σ channel test placing the suggested lower limit in `LOW_ANGLE_UNMODELLED`'s suggestion, the second literal the WP names; issue #1219 proposes dropping that suggestion. To lift at part 2, or to go with it.

_pawley_unresolved_diagnostics|1e-10|np..reason: Keeps esd/|I| finite at a zero intensity.

_renumber_atoms|4|stacklevel=4.reason: The `warnings.warn` stack level, so the warning names the caller's line.

_roughness_regime_diagnostics|0.5|tau >.reason: The info band of `ROUGHNESS_OUTSIDE_REGIME`: τ above half of sin θ_min. To lift at part 2.

_scale_b_ridge_diagnostics|3|n > 3.reason: Marks with an ellipsis the held displacement paths the message lists, cut at three (`held[:3]`); `where` carries them all.

_scale_b_ridge_diagnostics|100.0|100.0 *.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_scale_b_ridge_diagnostics|2.0|math.expm.reason: The 2 of the Debye-Waller factor exp(−2B s²) for intensity.

_size_flag_diagnostics|10.0|SIZE_FLAG_SI.reason: Å to nm in the message.

_size_flag_diagnostics|10.0|size_a / 10..reason: Å to nm in the message.

_wavelength_calibration_diagnostics|1000.reason: Relative shift to ppm in the message.

_window_loss_diagnostics|100|100 * sr.wi.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_window_loss_diagnostics|100|100 * tol.reason: Fraction to per cent in the message.

_in|3|len(ids) <= 3.reason: Names up to three documents in full, beyond that the first and the last with the count.
